name: Biopharma source registry (10 sources)
description: Official free sources for Hong Kong and US biopharma research. Six in the base-analysis layer, four in the upstream tracker. Scripts enter through biopharma_data.py and biopharma_tracker.py.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
sources.purpose: Global phase mix, indication breadth, NCT status

sources.name: FDA openFDA
sources.purpose: FDA approvals plus Orange Book ingredient and market status

sources.name: EMA EPAR
sources.purpose: EU approval, indication, and therapeutic area, with a 7-day local cache

sources.name: PubMed (NCBI)
sources.purpose: Where new clinical data lands first (ASCO/ASH, ORR/PFS/OS)

sources.name: Google Patents
sources.purpose: Patent expiry estimate and active status by country

sources.name: NMPA clinical-trial registry
sources.purpose: China CTR id, status, and indication. Playwright headed mode. Query with the Chinese INN.

sources.name: CDE priority review and breakthrough therapy
sources.purpose: Months ahead of a China approval. Catalyst calendar only, not a buy signal. Company names in the query stay Chinese.

sources.name: EMA CHMP meeting highlights
sources.purpose: 4-7 days ahead of an EU approval. Actionable.

sources.name: SEC 8-K (EDGAR full-text)
sources.purpose: The US partner files the BD or the data first. Useless if the partner is not a US listing.

sources.name: Trade-press RSS (7 feeds)
sources.url: Endpoints / Fierce Biotech / Fierce Pharma / BioPharma Dive / STAT / PharmaTimes / GEN
sources.purpose: BD leaks. Cross-check the partner 8-K. False reports happen.
